scope: Local interface and physics checks, not a reconstruction-quality benchmark

unit_and_integration_tests.second_stage_mixer: test-only differentiable mixer; production code requires official mamba-ssm

managed_generation.tests: bcdi_training/tests/test_generation.py plus existing BCDI training contracts
checks: Default layout is 16000 train / 2000 val / 2000 test
Serial and two-process generation produce identical final files and manifests
Resume regenerates an unfinished seed without changing dataset identity
Changed configurations, corrupted completed seeds and concurrent writers are rejected
Generated arrays pass the existing training reader and physical pairing validator

provided_example_parity.configuration: 3 seeds starting at 0, 2x2 samples per seed, author convention

limitations: The default local Python has an incompatible NumPy/Matplotlib binary combination; visualization succeeded in the existing compatible spikingformer environment.
Official Mamba CUDA kernels and full two-stage GPU training were not executed locally.
Twelve demonstration samples are insufficient for a formal performance experiment.
